shows.title: Candy Love Island
shows.description: Candylicious falls for Donutello, but every love-room vote, recoupling, and Casa Sweety temptation gives him a new chance to break her heart. In this candy-coated villa, crushes are strategy and every kiss can send someone home.

shows.title: Fruit Love Island
shows.description: Pineapple wants Banana. Watermelon wants Banana. Then Strawberry walks in and blows everything up. In this absurd tropical dating show, every new fruit arrival brings a fresh hookup, a jealous meltdown, or someone getting dumped from paradise.

shows.title: Basketball
shows.description: An underdog basketball story about training, team pressure, and fighting to be recognized when everyone else has already counted you out.

shows.title: Balenciaga Harry Potter
shows.description: A wizard fantasy gets restyled as a high-fashion fever dream, where familiar magical drama is filtered through runway poses, luxury attitude, and meme-level glam.

shows.title: Breaking Bad Balenciaga
shows.description: A prestige crime remix with a luxury-fashion makeover, turning danger, power, and criminal swagger into a surreal runway-ready parody.

shows.title: Harry Potter WW2
shows.description: A wizard-war remix that throws magical fantasy into an alternate WWII battlefield, turning prophecy, uniforms, and survival into a dark cinematic mashup.

shows.title: Double Shelf Life: Mark's Greed
shows.description: Linda sacrifices everything for Mark, only to discover he is spending her savings on his mistress. Now she is collecting receipts, planning a glow-up, and setting a dinner-table trap that could ruin them both.

shows.title: One Night in Fruitopia
shows.description: Strawberry wakes in a billionaire CEO's bed after an anonymous night on a yacht, then loses everything before fate drags him back into her life six years later. He never forgot her, but his protection may come with a price.

shows.title: Mad Durian: His Red Bride
shows.description: Raspberry is dragged into Durian's dangerous world after being betrayed and sold out. As his threats turn into protection, she has to learn whether she is only a replacement for the bride he lost.

shows.title: The Eye of Betrayal
shows.description: After an eye transplant, Pear sees her husband with her stepsister and realizes he is poisoning her, stealing her assets, and framing her for murder. To survive, she pretends to be blind while a ghost points her toward revenge.

shows.title: I Married My Ex's Mafia Boss
shows.description: After her ex humiliates her in front of his real fiancee, Strawberry accepts a ruthless matriarch's offer: marry a powerful mafia heir and make them beg. But her revenge marriage starts turning into protection, power, and a new life she controls.

shows.title: Secrets in the Juice
shows.description: Starfruit escapes a corrupt juice factory after proving healthy workers are being labeled rotten for profit. When the powerful Pomegranate protects him, the investigation becomes a dangerous affair that could expose a family algorithm and destroy his marriage.

shows.title: Screen Time
shows.description: Two couples are trapped by an anonymous voice that knows every text, affair, and bank secret. At 6 p.m. each night they must confess or watch their private lives get exposed to everyone.

shows.title: The Beast Queen's Canvas
shows.description: A broke artist is pulled into a brutal fantasy world where her blood-painted creatures come alive. With three beast-shifter protectors and a magic brush, she turns survival into a campaign to take the throne.
